rules.rationale: Defines the local cast-domain predicate definedProjectInt directly as the imported Int sort predicate isInt.
Adds an unproved simplification characterizing the definedness of the imported partial Val-to-Int cast; Stage 1 supplies no prior rule-free proof of this exact rule.
Guardedly defines the local named proof term projectIntTotal by the existing partial Int projection on its declared domain.
Provides the symbolic normalization orientation of the same guarded projectIntTotal definition, naming a defined partial cast with the local proof term.
Defines the projection helper on an already statically typed Int by collapsing it to that Int.
Supplies a structural normalization equation for the local projection helper, making nested projection applications idempotent.
Extends the imported applyBin operation with an unproved guarded simplification over dynamically sorted Val operands; prove.sh never proves this exact correspondence in a module excluding the rule.
Defines the empty-sequence base case of the recursive allNonNegative input-domain predicate.
Defines the nonempty recursive case of allNonNegative by checking the head and recurring on the tail.
Defines the mathematical shouldTake condition that mirrors the source loop's evenness, sentinel, and strict-minimum test.
Defines nextBest in the selecting branch by returning the current candidate value.
Defines nextBest in the complementary nonselecting branch by preserving the previous best value.
Defines nextBestIndex in the selecting branch by returning the current scan index.
Defines nextBestIndex in the complementary nonselecting branch by preserving the previous index.
Defines the empty-sequence base case of the scanBest recurrence.
Defines the nonempty scanBest recurrence by consuming one element, advancing the index, and updating the accumulator.
Defines the empty-sequence base case of the scanBestIndex recurrence.
Defines the nonempty scanBestIndex recurrence while threading the updated best value, best index, and next position.
Defines afterIndex on an empty remaining sequence as the current index.
Defines the recursive afterIndex case by consuming one sequence element and incrementing the index.
Defines resultList for the negative no-selection sentinel as the empty Python-list value.
Defines resultList for a selected nonnegative best value as the two-element value-and-index list.
